candidates.title: Civil Works Project Officer
candidates.abstract: Support the delivery of civil infrastructure projects by managing contractors, inspections and reinstatement works across Council assets
bullets: Supportive and Friendly team environment where we value growth and development
Support the delivery of civil infrastructure projects by managing contractors, i
Help maintain the roads, footpaths and public spaces
candidates.content_text:
Civil Works Project Officer
Temporary Full Time - until 16th April 2027
Band 5 – Starting from $80,410.06 + super + RDO (RDO applicable for full-time 38 hours per week only)
Why You’ll Want to Join Us
- Supportive and friendly team environment where we value growth and development
- Make a positive impact on our community
- Work in a dynamic and collaborative environment
About the Role
The Development and Civil Engineering team oversees and inspects reinstatement works on Council's roads and footpaths. In this role, you will supervise and provide technical support and guidance to third-party contractors completing reinstatement works on Council assets. You will ensure that all civil works within the Council’s road reserve adhere to council requirements and industry best practices. Additionally, you will be responsible for maintaining public safety and ensuring compliance with relevant legislation, permits, and consents.
Key Responsibilities:
- Supervise civil rectification works for development and subdivision sites, ensuring compliance with standards, permit conditions, and traffic management plans.
- Define and prepare detailed scopes of reinstatement works on Council’s roads, footpaths, and land, ensuring clarity and alignment with Council’s specifications.
- Conduct site assessments to determine the extent of reinstatement required and identify any potential issues.
- Manage and coordinate contractors, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure a clear understanding of the scope and requirements of reinstatement works.
- Implement quality assurance measures to monitor and verify that reinstatement works meet the defined scope and Council standards.
- Carry out proactive and reactive inspections in line with the requirements of the Council’s Road Management Plan, Local Law Permits, and other relevant legislation
What We’re Looking For
We are seeking a results-driven individual who excels in both collaborative team settings and independent work environments.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional time management skills, effectively planning and organising a high workload to meet established priorities. Experience in project delivery or a similar role within the infrastructure or construction sectors is highly desirable.
Need More Info?
For further information, please refer to the Position Description or contact Justin Cochrane, Team Leader Development and Civil Engineering at Justin.cochrane@yarracity.vic.gov.au
 901522 - Civil Works Project Officer - Infrastructure Environment - Position Description October (2).pdf
Applications close on: Sunday 22 November at 11.55pm  
How to Apply
In your application, please include your Resume and a 1-page Cover Letter. In your cover letter, provide a brief overview addressing the Key Selection Criteria as outlined in the Position Description. A separate document addressing KSC is not required.
Additional Information
This position is subject to satisfactory Police Check prior to commencement. Pre-employment checks are not used by Yarra City Council to prevent any applicant from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.
At Yarra Every Job is a Climate Job! Acting on the climate emergency requires that we change the way we think, make decisions, and prioritise action. We must embed proactive climate responses in the ways we govern, live our lives, and conduct our work. Every choice we make today and into the future will have an impact; this is true for Council and the community.
Acknowledging the scale of this crisis, at Yarra we are committed to ensuring that every job is a climate job meaning that each staff member will play a key role in shaping our climate response.
Yarra's Commitment to Diversity
Yarra City Council is committed to being a child safe organisation and supports flexible and accessible working arrangements for all. This includes people with a disability, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, culturally, religiously and linguistically diverse people, young people, older people, women, and people who identify as gay, lesbian, bisexual, transgender, intersex or queer. 
We draw pride and strength from our diversity, remain open to new approaches and actively foster an inclusive workplace that celebrates the contribution made by all our people.

candidates.title: Junior Project Engineer - Traffic
candidates.abstract: At McConnell Dowell, we're not just looking for graduates. We're looking for future project leaders. Build more than projects. Build your career.
bullets: Kick-start your career on a major infrastructure project
candidates.content_text:
McConnell Dowell is delivering the South Package of the Yan Yean Road Upgrade, a significant infrastructure project designed to improve safety, reduce congestion and enhance connectivity for Melbourne's growing northern communities. Operating from our project office in the Yarrambat/Doreen area, we are seeking a Junior Engineer to join the team
This is a rare opportunity for a recently qualified Engineer to join one of Australasia's most respected construction and engineering businesses and gain exposure across the full project lifecycle. Unlike many graduate roles that focus on a single discipline, this position provides broad exposure to the delivery of a major infrastructure project. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and project leaders, gaining practical experience across engineering, construction, commercial, procurement, safety and quality while building the skills and confidence to accelerate your career in the construction industry.
What you'll be doing:
 Working as part of our Engineering team, you'll support a range of activities including:
 - Support experienced engineers in the design, coordination and delivery of temporary and permanent works solutions.
 - Work closely with project teams to deliver construction activities safely, efficiently and in accordance with project specifications.
 - Assist with project planning, scheduling and progress tracking to help ensure key milestones are achieved.
 - Develop commercial skills through exposure to procurement, cost control, contract administration and subcontractor management.
 - Contribute to safety, quality and environmental initiatives, helping uphold McConnell Dowell's commitment to Home Without Harm.
 - Build practical engineering experience by collaborating with construction, engineering and project management professionals on a major infrastructure project.
 What we're looking for:
 - Recent graduate (or graduating soon) with a Civil or Mechanical Engineering degree
 - Interest in traffic engineering, traffic management or transport infrastructure (highly regarded)
 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills
 - Genuine passion for infrastructure and construction
 - Eagerness to learn from experienced industry professionals
 - Positive attitude and commitment to safety
 We offer:
 - Mentoring from experienced industry professionals
 - Exposure across traffic engineering, project delivery, commercial and construction management
 - Opportunities to work on major infrastructure projects
 - A supportive and collaborative team environment
 - Clear pathways for career growth and development
 If you're looking for more than a typical graduate role and want the opportunity to fast-track your development with a leading infrastructure business, we'd love to hear from you.
About Us
 McConnell Dowell – Creative Construction
 Our purpose is Providing a Better Life. We do that through delivering projects that connect, support and sustain communities, and through providing career opportunities that challenge, reward and grow our people. 
 From remote major resources and energy projects to city-shaping transport and water infrastructure, we have constructed thousands of high-quality, complex projects for our customers and communities over more than 60 years, in Australia, New Zealand, the Pacific Islands and Southeast Asia.
 Why join us?
 The work you’ll do will have a tangible positive impact on people’s lives, including yours. The diversity of our projects, roles and locations means greater development opportunities. We invest in our people to set and reach personal and professional goals and we have some of the best mentoring minds in the business to help you do that.  Because when you grow, we all grow.
 McConnell Dowell actively seeks and celebrates diversity, inclusion, and individuality. In a culture low on ego and high on support, we encourage everyone to make an impact. We're big enough to take on community-shaping projects, but agile enough for you to have an influence on how we do things.
So, join us, be you, and help us create better together. Apply now!
We are an equal opportunity employer. People of all ages, abilities, sexual orientation, gender identities & cultures including Aboriginal, and Torres Strait Islanders are strongly encouraged to apply.
 Please note all successful applicants must hold valid work rights for Australia and pass a satisfactory pre-employment medical which includes drug and alcohol checks. 
 This role is being sourced through McConnell Dowell directly and not accepting applications via external recruitment agencies.

candidates.content_text:
Cadets - Victoria
About Erilyan
Operating across Australia, Erilyan delivers the critical projects that shape Australia's future, projects that demand precision, reliability, and true partnership. With a team of more than 200 professionals, we specialise in Australia's critical sectors including healthcare, data centres, commercial, and other complex environments. We partner with clients who value collaboration, transparency, and a commitment to excellence, working together to deliver when it matters, The Erilyan Way.
The Opportunity
We’re growing, and we’re looking for multiple Cadets to join our teams in Victoria. This is a hands-on role designed for people who want to learn construction from the inside. You’ll gain real experience across the different fields of construction, supported by experienced professionals who will help you build your skills and your career. Interviews will take place in November and December, with a start date of 27 January 2027.
In this role you will:
- Rotate through contract administration, site administration and coordination, engineering, preconstruction and estimating
- Support project teams with document control, procurement, RFIs, variations, programming and cost reporting
- Get on site to attend meetings, complete site diaries, log deliveries and carry out inspections and progress photos
- Contribute to safety and quality processes, including site inductions, toolbox talks and HSEQ inspections
- Use industry software such as Jobpac, CostX, Procore and EstimateOne
Why Join Erilyan
- Competitive salaries with annual reviews.
- A structured capability framework to guide your progression.
- Paid parental leave.
- Four Wellbeing Days + Birthday Leave. *
- Training, mentoring, and leadership programs.
- Opportunities to contribute to community and charity initiatives like ReLove.
- A people-focused culture that recognises and celebrates your achievements.
About You
- Currently studying or have recently finished a degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, WHS, or a related field
- Strong attention to detail and a confident communicator
- Basic understanding of construction plans (or a keen interest to learn)
- Takes ownership of tasks, and values constructive feedback. 
Our Brand Values
Genuine, Progressive, Effective. At Erilyan, we’re upfront, innovative, and get the job done to the highest standard.  If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a supportive, high-performing team, apply now and start building your future with us.
*Subject to eligibility
Erilyan have preferred suppliers in place and do not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies.
